# Slates

Slates is a desktop AI video studio you buy once and keep. This plugin connects your AI to it, so your AI can run the whole production with you. It writes the script, builds characters and storyboards, shows you the price before anything generates, makes the images and video, and lays the cut out on the timeline, ready to export to DaVinci Resolve or Premiere. Every project and file stays on your own computer.

You need the Slates desktop app on Windows or macOS and a Slates account with credits. If the app isn't set up yet, the plugin walks you through installing and connecting it, then hands the work to the Slates tools.

## What you need

Keep the Slates desktop app running while your AI works on your projects. If it isn't installed or connected yet, the bundled `slates-connect` skill walks you through it.

## Install

Install this plugin from the Claude directory.

If you connected Slates from the app's Settings before, remove that older `slates` server registration so the tools are not listed twice.

## Bundled skills

- **slates-connect**: Install, open, connect, or repair Slates when its slates_* tools are missing or fail to reach the desktop app. Do not use when Slates tools already work; continue with the user's request instead.
- **slates-start-here**: Start any Slates job here: the Director card (how every job begins) and the router that names the playbook for each job, the rules it links and the question to ask first. Read it before planning an ad, a film, a cut or any other piece.
